scientific_scope: The four-counter integer recurrence has O(M^5) transitions and O(M^4) rolling states for fixed-half selected-row inputs and protected endpoints, with additional readout, comparison, bit and witness costs.

The rational reconstruction does not make the float-converting model_inputs/maximize a generic exact-rational oracle. The Fraction counterexample and additive correction remain exact. No bitwise pilot-input or generic neural argmax certificate is claimed.

The benchmark evaluates a fixed smoothed gate Q with clean-history B and float64 CE, not a trained neural readout. There are 36 initial and nine outcome-informed follow-up cases on 12 saved histories from three fixed source tables.
Higher float64 CE does not imply larger source error: four initial cases reverse that ranking. The nine follow-up cases reuse observed histories and are not independent confirmation.

The preserved C++/Python timings have different intervals; entire_case_wall_s is whole evaluation, not isolated subprocess time. Runtime caps do not establish a hard end-to-end deadline. No controlled throughput or general practical-efficiency claim.

All actual retained scripts, configuration, binary, 45 case records with 900 proposal entries, 448 test rows, 5,976 retrospective oracle entries and reconstruction archives are included. Missing records are explicitly not recovered.

No new scientific random values, model initializations, native timing or unsafe historical replays were generated in preparation. The new public verifier uses only saved values and deterministic enumeration.
